app.name: Live Transcribe
app.description: Live captioning app for d/Deaf and hard of hearing users in 145+ languages. Transcribes speech to text in real time using the device microphone.

verdict.one_liner: A genuinely useful accessibility app, but it serves ads and shares some data with advertisers and third-party vendors.
verdict.summary: Live Transcribe is built to help d/Deaf and hard-of-hearing users follow conversations in real time. The app needs microphone access to do its job, which it handles responsibly, but it also uses third-party advertising companies and shares some usage data for marketing purposes. The privacy policy is readable and gives users a way to delete their data.
verdict.recommendation_reason: The app does its core job well and handles microphone access transparently, but the ad tracking and third-party data sharing are unnecessary for an accessibility tool.

red.title: Third-party ads and trackers
red.plain_english: The app uses outside advertising companies to show you ads. These companies can collect info about how you use the app and combine it with data from other websites and apps to target you with ads.

red.title: Facebook Custom Audience tool
red.plain_english: If you give the app your email address, it can be converted into a code that Facebook uses to match you with ads on its platform. Facebook may then show you personalized ads based on your app usage.

red.title: Data shared with vendors
red.plain_english: The company shares your information with outside vendors who help run the app, including companies that handle data analysis, email delivery, hosting, and marketing. Some of these vendors may collect tracking data about how you interact with the app over time.

green.title: Microphone use is clear and limited
green.plain_english: The app only accesses your microphone when you actively start a transcription, which is the entire purpose of the app. It does not record in the background or share recordings with anyone.

green.title: No contact list access
green.plain_english: The app does not ask to see your contacts, phonebook, or address book.

green.title: No GPS or precise location tracking
green.plain_english: The app does not track your exact location. It only sees broad data like your country and IP address, which is common for most apps.

green.title: Users can request data deletion
green.plain_english: You can email the company to ask for your personal information to be reviewed, updated, or deleted. They say they will respond within 30 days.

green.title: Email is optional
green.plain_english: The app works fully without requiring your email address. You only need to share it if you choose to contact support or subscribe to updates.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The app needs your microphone to transcribe speech. It only turns on when you start a transcription and never runs in the background.
categories.detail: The privacy policy states the app may request access to the mobile device microphone. This is essential for the core live transcription feature. The app does not record audio in the background or share recordings with third parties.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may request access or permission to certain features from your mobile device, including your mobile device's microphone.

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The app does not track your exact location. It only sees your general country from your internet connection.
categories.detail: No GPS or precise location data is collected. The policy mentions country and IP address as part of automatically collected device/usage information, but this is broad network-level data, not location tracking.
categories.policy_excerpt: This information may include device and usage information, such as your IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, referring URLs, device name, country, location...

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The app does not ask for or access your contacts.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention any collection or access to contacts, phonebook, or address book data.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The app can save transcripts to other apps on your phone, but only when you choose to do so.
categories.detail: Users can manually send transcripts through messaging apps or save them to note-taking apps. This is user-initiated sharing, not automatic or broad file access.
categories.policy_excerpt: Send transcripts through any message app on your phone. Save transcripts to any note taking app on your phone.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: The company shares your data with outside vendors for things like data analysis, email delivery, and marketing. It also uses third-party advertising companies that can track your activity.
categories.detail: The policy states data may be shared with third-party vendors for services including payment processing, data analysis, email delivery, hosting, customer service, and marketing efforts. Selected third parties are allowed to use tracking technology on the apps. Third-party advertising companies serve ads.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may share your data with third party vendors, service providers, contractors or agents who perform services for us or on our behalf... We may allow selected third parties to use tracking technology on the Apps... We may use third-party advertising companies to serve ads when you visit the Apps.
concerns: Tracking technology allowed for selected third parties
Facebook Custom Audience tool used for ad personalization

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: The app collects your device info and may ask for your email, but the email is optional. Your device info may be used for ads and analytics.
categories.detail: Automatically collected data includes IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, device name, country, and mobile device ID, model, and manufacturer. Email address is optional.
categories.policy_excerpt: We automatically collect certain information when you visit, use or navigate the Apps... device and usage information, such as your IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, referring URLs, device name, country, location...
concerns: Device ID and IP address collected automatically
Data used for marketing and analytics

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: The app uses outside advertising companies and Facebook tools to show you targeted ads based on how you use the app.
categories.detail: Third-party advertising companies serve ads and may use cookies and tracking technologies. Facebook Custom Audience Tool is used to personalize ads by converting email addresses into unique numbers for matching with Facebook users.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may use third-party advertising companies to serve ads when you visit the Apps. These companies may use information about your visits to our Website(s) and other websites that are contained in web cookies and other tracking technologies... We may also use a tool offered by Facebook called Custom Audience Tool to personalize our ads on their platform.
concerns: Facebook Custom Audience for ad personalization

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: The app says it does not knowingly collect data from children under 18.
categories.detail: The policy explicitly states the company does not knowingly solicit data from or market to children under 18 years of age. If data from users under 18 is discovered, the account will be deactivated and data promptly deleted.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not knowingly solicit data from or market to children under 18 years of age.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: The app logs your internet address and device details to keep the app running and for analytics.
categories.detail: IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, referring URLs, device name, country, and location are automatically collected for security, operation, internal analytics, and reporting.
categories.policy_excerpt: This information may include device and usage information, such as your IP address, browser and device characteristics, operating system, language preferences, referring URLs, device name, country, location...
concerns: Usage data used for analytics and reporting

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: The app collects details about your phone like its model and operating system for analytics and to keep the app working.
categories.detail: Mobile device ID, model, manufacturer, operating system, and version information are automatically collected. This is standard device diagnostics data, but it is also used for analytics and marketing.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may automatically collect device information (such as your mobile device ID, model and manufacturer), operating system, version information and IP address.
concerns: Used for analytics and marketing purposes

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The app does not collect health or biometric data.
categories.detail: No health, medical, or biometric data collection is mentioned in the privacy policy.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: The app is free and does not handle payments in the core experience.
categories.detail: While the policy mentions order fulfillment and payments in a generic business context, the app itself is free on the App Store and does not have in-app purchases described in the policy for the transcription service.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can email the company to ask for your data to be deleted, and they say they will reply within 30 days. However, there is no automatic self-delete button in the app.
categories.detail: Users can request to review, update, or delete personal information by contacting support@mightyfine.app. The company promises a response within 30 days. No automated self-service deletion is mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: To request to review, update, or delete your personal information, please visit: support@mightyfine.app. We will respond to your request within 30 days.
concerns: Deletion request is manual via email

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: The company can update its privacy rules at any time, and the new rules take effect immediately. They may tell you about big changes, but continued use counts as agreeing.
categories.detail: The policy states it may be updated from time to time, and the updated version is effective as soon as it is accessible. Material changes may be notified by posting a notice or sending a direct notification.
categories.policy_excerpt: The updated version will be indicated by an updated 'Revised' date and the updated version will be effective as soon as it is accessible. If we make material changes... we may notify you either by prominently posting a notice of such changes or by directly sending you a notification.
